facts.text: The party must bring metal from the Dwarven mine back to Warwick the smith; in exchange he lent them his mithril chain shirt. He keeps Sir Phidipaldi's lyre and holds the party's plate armor as collateral.
The party must return Warwick's mithril chain shirt, which Ingrid says was his grandfather's armor, to him. No return date or condition was set.
facts.uncertain_reason: Play never stated when or on what condition the shirt must be returned.

facts.text: Wayman wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt over his leather armor. It greatly improves his protection and halves damage from magic weapons and spells. It is on loan from Warwick.
Warwick holds the party's plate armor as collateral. Sir Phidipaldi claims it is Sir Brandon's original, verifiable with Brother Dirk. The party can presumably reclaim it by completing the deal.
facts.uncertain_reason: Play never stated the terms on which the plate armor is returned.

facts.text: A cave-in seals the post-and-lintel entrance of the Dwarven mine, blocking the party from getting metal for Warwick. It looks natural and can be dug through; Dunk has begun breaking into it, uncovering a dead dwarf.

The Dwarven mine is marked on the treasure map, north past King Hogboon's goblin-held temple ruins, which the party slipped around undetected. Its log cabin is burnt to a rotting heap. No armed resistance was expected there.
Is there still metal to be had in the Dwarven mine beyond the cave-in, now that the cabin is burnt and the dwarves who worked it are gone?
